# semaphore_ex_project_task_reject (Action)

Explicit task control. Confirm/reject require an active task runner; recovery retry requires an eligible persisted task and recovery manager. Executes only through explicit Action invocation. Progress reports a bounded, non-secret summary.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "semaphore_ex_project_task_reject" "example" {
  config {
    project_id = 1
    task_id    = 2
  }
}

# terraform apply -invoke=action.semaphore_ex_project_task_reject.example
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number)
- `task_id` (Number)
